description: Grants for the chromeless desktop-layer live-wallpaper windows — `wallpaper` (Windows WorkerW, one spanning the virtual screen) and `wallpaper-<n>` (one per screen on macOS, one per output on Linux layer-shell). Without a capability of its own the window can't call plugin:event|listen, so the 'live-spec' pushes from live_win/live_mac/live_linux would be silently dropped after the first apply.
